data.notes: November is unusually split between arena-scale K-pop/pop, J-pop festival traffic at KINTEX, and bass/electronic club bookings in Itaewon and Seongsu.

events.title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 〈STEAL THE WIND〉 IN SEOUL
events.summary: TOMORROW X TOGETHER open their 〈STEAL THE WIND〉 Seoul run with three shows at KSPO DOME. NOL lists performances on November 13, 14 and 15 with soundcheck and M&G ticket tiers.

events.title: WONDERLIVET 2026
events.summary: WONDERLIVET returns to KINTEX as a three-day J-pop and iconic-artist festival. The official site confirms November 20–22 at Halls 7–10 with a 42-team lineup.

events.title: 2026 Korea Grand Music Award
events.summary: The 2026 Korea Grand Music Award is confirmed for two days at Gocheok Sky Dome. Published lineups include K-pop and pop acts such as ITZY, tripleS, P1Harmony, KISS OF LIFE, xikers, MEOVV, FIFTY FIFTY and others.

events.title: 5 Seconds of Summer Live in Korea
events.summary: 5 Seconds of Summer list Seoul, South Korea at KINTEX Hall 1 on their official tour page for November 19. The show is part of their late-2026 Asia routing.

events.title: Xdinary Heroes Concert 〈IMPULSE〉
events.summary: JYP band Xdinary Heroes play three nights of 〈IMPULSE〉 at INSPIRE ARENA near Seoul. The ticket notice confirms showtimes on November 13, 14 and 15.

events.title: GLOBAL CALLING: CAMELPHAT
events.summary: UK electronic duo CamelPhat headline a six-hour GLOBAL CALLING event at LION SUPER CLUB in Gangnam. The ticket page confirms a 19+ event running November 12–13.

events.title: UNDERCITY presents Friction
events.summary: UNDERCITY’s first drum-and-bass curation brings UK D&B figure Friction to Seoul with YUNJI, Seyn, Hime isnotdead, rom & BAAWLA and (x)pider, spanning jungle, liquid, neurofunk, jump-up and breakbeat influences.

events.title: Jason Mraz Asia Tour 2026 - Seoul
events.summary: Jason Mraz brings his Asia Tour 2026 to KINTEX Hall 1 in Goyang, just outside Seoul. NOL World confirms the November 14 date and standing ticket categories.

events.title: SJF at the Theater 2026 - Diana Krall
events.summary: Diana Krall appears at Sejong Grand Theater as part of SJF at the Theater 2026. Sejong Center lists the concert for November 22 at 6 PM with a 75-minute running time.

events.title: SJF at the Theater 2026 - Christopher
events.summary: Seoul Jazz Festival’s theater-format series presents Danish pop artist Christopher for two nights at Sejong Grand Theater. Melon Ticket confirms 8 PM shows on November 19 and 20.

events.title: LOUIS THE CHILD presented by OFFGRID
events.summary: OFFGRID brings Chicago electronic duo Louis The Child to Frame Seoul with local support from HE’S, HOWMINI, GUILTY PLEASURE, VANDAL ROCK and TWOC for a 23:00–05:00 pop-electronic club night.

events.title: Neffa-T: More Breaks & Kimchi Factory Homies present
events.summary: UK bass selector Neffa-T plays Cakeshop with HASHTAGPOPE, Tabris, Nimvy, untitled, MOONICE and RAFA. The RA listing bills the night around breakbeat and grime.

events.title: Dancehall Seoul Camp 2026
events.venueName: Studio SINNER / Sadang Steppin Studio / Hanz Club
events.summary: Dancehall Seoul’s two-day camp connects Korea’s dancehall community with international teachers, workshops, three battle categories and a confirmed late-night afterparty at Hanz Club in Hongdae.

events.title: Morgenshtern Alisher World Tour Part 2 Seoul
events.summary: Russian rapper Morgenshtern brings the second part of his world tour to Myunghwa Live Hall. NOL lists the show as a 19+ concert with an 8 PM start.

events.title: lift from Tokyo
events.summary: Tokyo party LIFT travels to vurt. with ABSIS and Junya Yamamura, joined by vurt. residents SJK and SUZAN for a focused techno exchange between Tokyo and Seoul underground crews.

events.title: 2026 HOUSE DANCE FUTURE vol.7
events.summary: Overaiz presents the seventh edition of Korea’s dedicated house-dance event: a 1-on-1 house battle, DJ-led special jam session, Japanese and Korean judges, and guest showcases for Seoul’s house music and dance community.

events.title: Jesse Gold - Live in Seoul
events.summary: Canadian singer-songwriter Jesse Gold plays Rolling Hall in Hongdae with VIP package and GA standing tickets. NOL lists the concert for November 16 at 8 PM.

events.title: LET ME KNOW LIVE TOUR 2026 - Re: Still Romance -
events.summary: LET ME KNOW bring the Re: Still Romance live tour to Myunghwa Live Hall. MyCon lists the Seoul concert for November 28 at 6 PM with standing and reserved-seat tickets.

events.title: Korea National Opera: Das Rheingold
events.summary: Korea National Opera stages Wagner’s Das Rheingold at Seoul Arts Center, opening its Ring cycle project. The Seoul Arts Center listing confirms performances from October 29 through November 1, 2026.

events.title: Víkingur Ólafsson Piano Recital
events.summary: Icelandic pianist Víkingur Ólafsson performs a solo recital at Seoul Arts Center Concert Hall. The venue listing confirms the date as November 1, 2026, at 17:00.

events.title: La Bohème
events.summary: Sejong Center presents Puccini’s La Bohème at the Grand Theater with four scheduled performances. The official Sejong listing confirms dates from November 5 to November 8, 2026.

events.title: Sir Simon Rattle & Bavarian Radio Symphony Orchestra
events.summary: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Bavarian Radio Symphony Orchestra at Seoul Arts Center Concert Hall. The Seoul Arts Center listing confirms the performance for November 12, 2026, at 19:30.

events.title: Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra: Hannu Lintu conducts Prokofiev’s Romeo & Juliet
events.summary: Hannu Lintu conducts the Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra in a program including Unsuk Chin, Richard Strauss’s Don Quixote and Prokofiev selections from Romeo and Juliet. NOL World confirms performances at LOTTE Concert Hall on November 19 and 20, 2026.

events.title: Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra: Jaap van Zweden conducts Mahler’s Fourth Symphony
events.summary: Jaap van Zweden leads the Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra with violist Antoine Tamestit and soprano Sumi Hwang in Gubaidulina and Mahler. NOL World confirms performances at LOTTE Concert Hall on November 26 and 27, 2026.

events.title: KBS Symphony Orchestra 832nd Subscription Concert
events.summary: Robert Spano conducts the KBS Symphony Orchestra with cellist Steven Isserlis in Barber, Schumann and Rimsky-Korsakov. The KBS Symphony listing confirms the concert for November 28, 2026, at Seoul Arts Center Concert Hall.
